_comment: Visitor-facing changes, newest first. Drafted from the commit history for the owner's review.
title: Updates
intro: What has changed here, newest first.

entries.label: 8 November 2026
items: Each page now ends by leading to the next chapter, and the home page lists every chapter in order.
Going back returns you to where you were on the page. On wide screens, the menu bar comes back when you scroll up.
Character and insight pages now link to each other, and the arrow keys move between them.
The contact form now prepares an email draft in your own mail app.
A small flower now marks the site in browser tabs.

entries.label: 7 November 2026
items: The whole site was rebuilt with new page transitions, motion and layout. The words and images stay the same.

entries.label: 16 October 2026
items: Languages are listed by their own names, and an address that does not exist now leads to a page of its own.

entries.label: 15 October 2026
items: Music: four songs, each with a short story.

entries.label: 13 October 2026
items: A copyright notice, a privacy notice and an index of where matching images appear online.

entries.label: 12 October 2026
items: The site opened in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese, with the gallery, three characters, two insights and an essay on why this story stays with me.
